author: claude-opus-5-5
visual_review: Water fountain faucet: a pipe drawn as a tube (walls 8 apart) rising at the right, running left along the top with rounded corners and ending in a downward spout; an outlined teardrop falls below the spout; a base stroke runs along the bottom. Follows the reference's pillar + spout + drop + base. Lucide-style tube construction.
omissions: The thick base plate is a single base stroke (a plate 8+ tall would crowd the drop); the pillar is the full tube rather than the reference's stepped two-level top.
